players.product: regulated transmission & distribution utilities (ComEd, PECO, BGE, PHI) interconnecting data-center load in PJM

quarterly_data.signal: Exelon's Q2 2026 earnings release (Exhibit 99.1), ComEd Statistics: large commercial & industrial electric deliveries were 7,637 GWh in the three months ended June 30, 2026, versus 6,731 GWh a year earlier (+13.5%; weather-normal +6.1%), and 14,599 GWh versus 13,734 GWh for the six months (+6.3%; weather-normal +2.4%). Q2 large C&I deliveries at the other utilities: PECO +3.4% (weather-normal +2.4%), BGE -1.6% (-0.6%), Pepco -2.0% (-2.6%), DPL -1.4% (-0.9%), ACE -1.8% (-2.0%). The release does not break the customer class down by end use.
